scope: Theme Lab recipe adapter: generated real Kvantum SVG/config for scroll_h and scroll_v only; native Qt6 style preview wiring.
reference: Domain/OS SR10.4 + HP VUE 2.01; shared tools/domainos_scrollbar_rules.json
implemented: Kvantum backend availability now identifies an implemented private SVG/metrics adapter.
Recipe geometry drives 15px bar, 2px relief, 11px odd arrow glyph and 15px configuration dimensions; custom valid odd dimensions also scale by integer cells.
Palette roles are resolved from the selected KDE scheme and emitted only into a private generated preview snapshot; changing palette changes paint without changing geometry.
Qt6 gallery route verifies the complete saved private receipt, selected Kvantum style class and loaded plugin before rendering real Qt widgets; no QSS palette injection.
The private theme is installed inside the preview XDG_CONFIG_HOME/Kvantum/<theme> path that Kvantum resolves; earlier XDG_DATA_HOME/Kvantum placement silently fell back to the system theme.
The Kvantum-native Qt6 preview opens the Scroll tab so both visible bars are measured and captured rather than reporting hidden controls.
Shared contract scene selection supports Kvantum, while this adapter refuses controls other than horizontal/vertical scrollbars.
The companion installer packages the shared scrollbar contract runtime dependency.

limitations: Adapter covers only scrollbar appearance, not all Kvantum controls.
Kvantum owns range, page size, wheel, drag and native interaction.
Kvantum configuration does not expose independent 4px viewport/bar or arrow/thumb gap metrics; those are not simulated.
This receipt is not user approval.
Kvantum has no independent setting for viewport/bar spacing; the measured 4px comes from the tested QScrollArea/frame layout and is not guaranteed for every Qt application.
